clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn needs Kodo Liver for a strange ale. He learned to brew trogg ale from the wandering brewmaster Chen Stormstout.

Kodos roam the Barrens, where tauren and predators hunt them for their hides and meat. In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn uses a fresh Kodo Liver with thunderhawk saliva glands and lightning glands to make trogg ale. Chen Stormstout taught Drohn the recipe, and Drohn says the blend packs a potent kick for adventurous travelers. The ingredients come from the wilds of central Kalimdor.
